headline: Record revenues and hundred-million debts. Czech internet provider Poda grew again and modernized its optics
summary: Ostrava-based internet provider Poda reported record revenues and higher business indicators for its financial year. The company also reported debts in the hundreds of millions of crowns and continued optical network modernisation.
why: Poda is a regional Czech telecom operator expanding its fibre network, and its results reflect demand for broadband in the Czech market.
